title: Adverbs (क्रियाविशेषण)
excerpt: Adverb rules: Adverbs of manner, place, time (MPT order), inversion after negative adverbs (hardly, seldom, scarcely), too vs very, and solved PYQs.
seo_description: Adverb rules: Adverbs of manner, place, time (MPT order), inversion after negative adverbs (hardly, seldom, scarcely), too vs very, and solved PYQs.
content:
1. What is an Adverb? (Definition & Function) (क्रिया विशेषण (Adverb) क्या है? (परिभाषा एवं कार्य))

An Adverb is a word used to modify or qualify the meaning of:

  • A Verb: She is walking slowly. (Modifies verb 'walking' - How?)
  • An Adjective: She is very intelligent. (Modifies adjective 'intelligent' - How much?)
  • Another Adverb: She is walking very slowly. (Modifies adverb 'slowly' - To what degree?)
💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

हिंदी व्याकरण में क्रिया विशेषण (Adverb) वह शब्द है जो किसी क्रिया (Verb), विशेषण (Adjective) या अन्य क्रिया विशेषण के अर्थ को स्पष्ट करता है, विशेषता बताता है या परिमाण तय करता है।

  • क्रिया की विशेषता: She is walking slowly. (वह धीरे-धीरे चल रही है।)
  • विशेषण की विशेषता: She is very intelligent. (वह बहुत बुद्धिमान है।)
  • अन्य Adverb की विशेषता: She is walking very slowly. (वह बहुत धीरे-धीरे चल रही है।)

2. Classification: 8 Types of Adverbs (क्रिया विशेषण के 8 प्रमुख प्रकार)

Kind (प्रकार) Key Adverbs List Question Answered & Meaning Example Sentence
1. Adverb of Time before, ago, lately, yet, now, soon, yesterday, already, never, today कब? (When?) — समय का बोध कराता है। He will arrive soon. (वह जल्द आएगा।)
2. Adverb of Frequency always, once, seldom, usually, rarely, often, frequently, hardly कितनी बार? (How often?) — आवृत्ति का बोध। She always speaks the truth.
3. Adverb of Place here, there, everywhere, down, near, away, backward, upward कहाँ? (Where?) — स्थान या दिशा का बोध। Please come here.
4. Adverb of Manner slowly, soundly, delightfully, bravely, easily, foolishly, clearly, well कैसे? किस ढंग से? (How / In what manner?) The soldiers fought bravely.
5. Adverb of Affirmation / Negation certainly, definitely, obviously, no, not, never, undoubtedly स्वीकृति या निषेध (पुष्टि या मनाही)। He will certainly help you.
6. Adverb of Degree / Quantity almost, fully, very, enough, rather, quite, too, really, so, extremely कितना? किस हद तक? (How much / To what extent?) I am too tired to walk.
7. Interrogative Adverb how, when, where, why प्रश्न पूछने वाले Adverbs. Where do you live?
8. Relative Adverb when, where, why, how दो उपवाक्यों को जोड़ने वाले (Adjective Clause बिनाते हैं)। This is the house where I was born.

3. The 13 Golden Rules of Adverbs for SSC Exams (SSC परीक्षाओं के लिए Adverb के 13 स्वर्णिम नियम)

Rule I & II: Adjective vs Adverb & Position of Frequency

1. Rule I: An Adjective qualifies a noun/pronoun, whereas an Adverb modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb.
2. Rule II: Adverbs of Frequency/Time (always, often, already, just, never, ever, seldom, usually, rarely, hardly, normally) are generally placed immediately before the main verb they modify (or after the auxiliary verb 'be').

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: 1. Noun की विशेषता बताने के लिए Adjective, और Verb की विशेषता बताने के लिए Adverb आता है।
2. Always, often, never, seldom, usually आदि शब्द हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया (Main Verb) से ठीक पहले या 'be' (is/am/are/was/were) के ठीक बाद आते हैं।
🔥 Spotting Error Examples (Rule I & II)

❌ Incorrect: She ran quicker than I.
✓ Correct: She ran more quickly than I. [दौड़ने की क्रिया का ढंग → Adverb 'more quickly'!]

❌ Incorrect: My brother comes often on Sundays.
✓ Correct: My brother often comes on Sundays. ['often' मुख्य क्रिया 'comes' से पहले!]

❌ Incorrect: He goes usually to the cinema every Friday.
✓ Correct: He usually goes to the cinema every Friday.

✓ Correct: He never talks ill of his friends. / He is always satisfied.

Rule III: Position of Adverbs of Manner (ढंग बताने वाले Adverb का स्थान)

• With Intransitive Verbs (अकर्मक क्रिया - No Object): The adverb of manner is placed only after the verb.
• With Transitive Verbs (सकर्मक क्रिया - With Object): The adverb can be placed either before the verb or after the object, but NEVER between the verb and its object.

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: • अकर्मक क्रिया के बाद ही Adverb आता है (e.g. He slept soundly).
• सकर्मक क्रिया में Adverb या तो क्रिया से पहले आएगा या Object के बाद, लेकिन क्रिया और Object के बीच में कभी नहीं आ सकता।
📝 Exam Examples (Rule III)

❌ Incorrect: He soundly slept last night.
✓ Correct: He slept soundly last night. ['slept' अकर्मक क्रिया है → Adverb बाद में!]

✓ Correct: He briefly narrated the incident to me.
✓ Correct: He narrated the incident to me briefly.

Rule IV: The Law of Inversion (इनवर्जन का नियम - अत्यधिक महत्वपूर्ण)

When a sentence begins with a negative or restrictive adverb (Seldom, Never, Hardly, Scarcely, Barely, Rarely, Little, Neither, Nor, No sooner, So quickly), the Inverted Form of the Verb must be used for emphasis:

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: जब कोई वाक्य किसी नकारात्मक या प्रतिबंधात्मक Adverb से शुरू होता है, तो वाक्य में Inversion (सहायक क्रिया + कर्ता + मुख्य क्रिया) का नियम लागू होता है:
⚡ The Inversion Formula

[Negative Adverb] + Auxiliary Verb (did/does/had/will/is) + Subject + Main Verb + ...

🔥 SSC CGL Questions on Inversion (Rule IV)

❌ Incorrect: Seldom he visits his parents.
✓ Correct: Seldom does he visit his parents. [हिंदी: वह कभी-कभार ही अपने माता-पिता से मिलने जाता है।]

❌ Incorrect: Never I will see her face again.
✓ Correct: Never will I see her face again. [हिंदी: मैं उसका चेहरा फिर कभी नहीं देखूँगा।]

❌ Incorrect: Hardly she had reached the station when the train left.
✓ Correct: Hardly had she reached the station when the train left. [हिंदी: वह स्टेशन पहुँची ही थी कि ट्रेन छूट गई।]

❌ Incorrect: No sooner she reached the station than the train arrived.
✓ Correct: No sooner did she reach (or had she reached) the station than the train arrived.

❌ Incorrect: So quickly she ran that she overtook her rivals.
✓ Correct: So quickly did she run that she overtook her rivals.

Rule V, VI & VII: Else...but, Never vs Not & Fixed Idiomatic Phrases

Rule Grammatical Requirement Correct & Incorrect SSC Examples
Rule V: Else & Other • Else is followed by BUT.
• Other / Otherwise is followed by THAN.		 ❌ It is nothing else than sheer madness.
✓ It is nothing else but sheer madness.
❌ She had no other alternative but stay here.
✓ She had no other alternative than stay here.
Rule VI: Never vs Not • Never: Means at no time (for habitual/general actions).
• Not: Used for a specific single past occasion.		 ❌ I never went to Ooty last year.
✓ I did not go to Ooty last year. (विशिष्ट बीते समय के लिए 'never' नहीं, 'did not' आएगा!)
✓ I never tell a lie. (आदतन - सही है)
Rule VII: Fixed Phrases चार सही मुहावरेदार वाक्यांश:
1. seldom or never
2. seldom, if ever
3. little or nothing
4. little, if anything		 ❌ We seldom or ever meet our relatives.
✓ We seldom or never (or seldom, if ever) meet our relatives.
❌ We have little or anything to say.
✓ We have little or nothing to say.

Rule VIII: Avoiding Double Negatives (दोहरे नकारात्मक शब्दों से बचें)

Negative adverbs should never be paired with another negative word in the same clause. Two negatives make an affirmative and create grammatical redundancy:

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: नकारात्मक अर्थ वाले शब्दों के साथ वाक्य में दूसरा नकारात्मक शब्द (not, no, none, nothing) लगाना सख्त वर्जित है:

⚠️ Words with Built-in Negative Meaning (इनके साथ 'not' कभी न लगाएं):
1. Negative Adverbs: seldom, nowhere, never, nothing, hardly, scarcely, barely, rarely, neither.
2. Negative Verbs: deny (इनकार करना), forbid (मना करना), prevent, prohibit.
3. Negative Conjunctions: until (जब तक कि नहीं - समय), unless (जब तक कि नहीं - शर्त), lest (कहीं ऐसा न हो कि + should).

🔥 SSC Error Spotting (Rule VIII)

❌ Incorrect: She hardly knows nothing about the family.
✓ Correct: She hardly knows anything about the family. ['nothing' की जगह 'anything'!]

❌ Incorrect: She denied that she had not stolen the watch.
✓ Correct: She denied that she had stolen the watch. ['denied' के बाद 'not' हटाएँ!]

❌ Incorrect: Both of us are not going to the party.
✓ Correct: Neither of us is going to the party. ('Both + not' अंग्रेजी में अशुद्ध है!)

❌ Incorrect: Wait here until I do not return.
✓ Correct: Wait here until I return.

Rule IX: Words Confused Between Adjectives & Adverbs (-ly वाले विशेषण)

A very common misconception is that every word ending in -ly is an adverb. Many words ending in -ly are strictly Adjectives!

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: छात्रों अक्सर सोचते हैं कि हर -ly वाला शब्द Adverb होता है। वास्तव में Noun + ly मिलकर Adjective बिनाते हैं:
Noun Form Adjective Form (-ly) Adverbial Form (ढंग बताने हेतु)
Coward (कायर व्यक्ति) Cowardly (कायरतापूर्ण) In a cowardly manner (कायरता से)
Miser (कंजूस व्यक्ति) Miserly (कंजूसी भरा) In a miserly manner (कंजूसी से)
Niggard (कंजूस) Niggardly (कंजूस) In a niggardly manner
Scholar (विद्वान) Scholarly In a scholarly manner
Friend (मित्र) Friendly In a friendly manner
Man (पुरुष) Manly (मर्दाना) In a manly manner
Order Orderly In an orderly manner / in order

⚠️ Crucial Vocabulary Pairs:
• Fast: 'Fastly' अंग्रेजी भाषा में कोई शब्द नहीं है! Fast ही Adjective और Adverb दोनों है (He runs fast).
• Outright: 'Outrightly' गलत है; सही शब्द outright है (She rejected the proposal outright).
• Hard vs Hardly: Hard = कठिन/मेहनत से (Affirmative); Hardly = लगभग नहीं (Negative).
• Late vs Lately: Late = देर से; Lately = हाल ही में (Recently).
• Loudly vs Aloud: Loudly = ऊँची कर्कश आवाज़ में; Aloud = इतनी आवाज़ में जो सुनी जा सके (Audibly).

🔥 SSC Shift Questions (Rule IX)

❌ Incorrect: A soldier is trained never to fight cowardly.
✓ Correct: A soldier is trained never to fight in a cowardly manner. [लड़ने का ढंग → Adverbial phrase!]

❌ Incorrect: He was driving very fastly.
✓ Correct: He was driving very fast. ['fastly' शब्द ही नहीं होता!]

❌ Incorrect: The teacher asked the students to speak loudly.
✓ Correct: The teacher asked the students to speak aloud. [ताकि सब सुन सकें → 'aloud'!]

Rule X: Very, Much, Too, So, Enough & Rather

1. Very vs Much (अत्यधिक vs बहुत)

Usage of 'Very' Usage of 'Much'
• Positive Degree के साथ: She is very good. • Comparative Degree के साथ: She is much better than her sister.
• Present Participle (V-ing) के साथ: a very interesting movie. • Past Participle (V3) के साथ: He was much exhausted / pleased.
• Superlative में: She is the very best student. • Superlative में: She is much the best student.

2. Position of 'Enough' (Enough का स्थान - बार-बार पूछा जाने वाला नियम)

⚠️ 'Enough' Placement Formula:
1. जब 'Enough' Adjective हो: यह Noun से पहले आता है:
👉 He has enough money to buy a car. ✓
2. जब 'Enough' Adverb हो: यह जिस Adjective (Positive Degree) की विशेषता बताता है, उसके हमेशा बाद में आता है:
❌ She is enough wise to understand the problem.
✓ She is wise enough to understand the problem. [Positive Degree + enough!]

3. 'Too... to' vs 'So... that'

• Too + Adjective + to + V1: नकारात्मक परिणाम दर्शाता है (इतना अधिक कि नहीं हो सकता):
👉 He is too weak to walk. = He is so weak that he cannot walk.
• केवल 'too' का प्रयोग 'very' के स्थान पर सकारात्मक अर्थ में न करें (He is too healthy ❌ → He is very healthy ✓).

Rule XI, XII & XIII: Echo Tags & Verbs that DROP 'As'

Rule XI: Echo Tags (So did I / Neither did I)

जब दो व्यक्ति एक ही कार्य करते हैं, तो दूसरे व्यक्ति की सहमति दर्शाने के लिए:

  • सकारात्मक वाक्य में (Affirmative): So + Auxiliary + Subject
    • She won the prize and so did her sister. (उसने पुरस्कार जीता और उसकी बहन ने भी।)
  • नकारात्मक वाक्य में (Negative): Neither + Auxiliary + Subject
    • He does not write well and neither do I. (वह अच्छा नहीं लिखता और न ही मैं।)

Rule XIII: Verbs Taking 'As' vs Verbs that DROP 'As' (100% SSC Favorite)

1. Verbs that TAKE 'As' (इनके बाद 'as' लगना अनिवार्य है):
regard, describe, define, treat, view, know
• I regard him as my mentor. ✓
• Science has been defined as the systematic study of nature. ✓

2. Verbs that DROP 'As' (इनके बाद 'as' लगाना सख्त अशुद्ध है):
name, elect, think, consider, call, appoint, make, choose
❌ She is considered as the best dancer. → ✓ She is considered the best dancer.
❌ The principal appointed him as peon. → ✓ The principal appointed him peon.
❌ He was elected as the secretary. → ✓ He was elected the secretary.
❌ The teacher called him as intelligent. → ✓ The teacher called him intelligent.

4. SSC CGL/CHSL Solved Shift Questions (PYQ Spotting Errors) (विगत वर्षों के हल प्रश्न (विस्तृत व्याख्या सहित))

Q1. SSC CGL Tier-1 Shift Question

Spot the error in the sentence:
"Scarcely had the bus stopped / when the passengers rushed / to get off the bus fastly / No error."

Answer & Detailed Explanation:
👉 Error is in Part 3. अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में fastly कोई शब्द नहीं होता। सही Adverb fast होता है।
✓ Correct Sentence: "Scarcely had the bus stopped when the passengers rushed to get off the bus fast."

Q2. SSC CHSL Tier-1 Shift Question

Spot the error in the sentence:
"He is enough rich / to buy a luxury bungalow / in the heart of the city / No error."

Answer & Detailed Explanation:
👉 Error is in Part 1. जब 'enough' Adverb के रूप में किसी Adjective की विशेषता बताता है, तो यह Adjective के बाद आता है। अतः enough rich अशुद्ध है, सही रूप rich enough होगा।
✓ Correct Sentence: "He is rich enough to buy a luxury bungalow in the heart of the city."

Q3. SSC CPO Tier-1 Shift Question

Spot the error in the sentence:
"The committee appointed him / as the head of the / finance department last month / No error."

Answer & Detailed Explanation:
👉 Error is in Part 2. क्रिया appoint, elect, consider के बाद 'as' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता।
✓ Correct Sentence: "The committee appointed him the head of the finance department last month."

5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) (अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न)

Q1. What is the Law of Inversion in adverbs?
Ans: When a sentence begins with a negative or restrictive adverb like Seldom, Hardly, Scarcely, Never, No sooner, the auxiliary verb is placed before the subject (e.g. Hardly had I arrived...).

Q2. Can 'cowardly' be used as an adverb?
Ans: No. 'Cowardly' is an adjective. To use it as an adverb of manner, you must use the phrase in a cowardly manner.

Q3. Which verbs do not take 'as'?
Ans: The verbs call, appoint, elect, consider, choose, make, name, think do not take 'as' before their complement.

title: Articles (A, An, The)
hindi_title: Articles (A, An, The) एवं Omission Rules
excerpt: Articles rules: Indefinite (A/An) sound rules, Definite Article (The) uses with geography/titles, Zero Article (omission rules), and solved PYQs.
seo_description: Articles rules: Indefinite (A/An) sound rules, Definite Article (The) uses with geography/titles, Zero Article (omission rules), and solved PYQs.
content:
1. What is an Article? (Definition & Kinds) (आर्टिकल (उपपद) क्या है? (वर्गीकरण एवं भेद))

Articles are demonstrative adjectives and determiners used before nouns to limit, define, or generalize their application in a sentence.

There are Two Kinds of Articles:

  1. Indefinite Articles (A, An): Used in the sense of 'one' or 'any' when talking about a person or thing mentioned for the first time or not specifically known.
  2. Definite Article (The): Used in the sense of 'this' or 'that' when pointing out a specific, particular, or previously mentioned entity.
💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में आर्टिकल केवल संज्ञा (Noun) के पूर्व प्रयुक्त होकर संज्ञा की निश्चितता या अनिश्चितता तय करते हैं। इनके दो मुख्य भेद हैं:

  1. अनिश्चित उपपद (Indefinite Articles - A, An): इनका अर्थ 'एक' या 'कोई भी' (any/one) होता है। ये केवल एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा (Singular Countable Nouns) से पहले आते हैं।
  2. निश्चित उपपद (Definite Article - The): इसका अर्थ 'वह खास / यह' (this/that/particular) होता है। यह एकवचन, बहुवचन और अगणनीय किसी भी संज्ञा से पहले आ सकता है जब संदर्भ निश्चित हो।

2. Choice Between 'A' and 'An' (ध्वनि पर आधारित नियम) ('A' और 'An' का सही चुनाव (उच्चारण का नियम))

नियम (Rule):
'A' और 'An' का चुनाव शब्द की स्पेलिंग (Spelling) से नहीं, बल्कि उसके प्रथम ध्वनि / उच्चारण (Initial Sound) से निर्धारित होता है:
• व्यंजन ध्वनि (Consonant Sound - क से ज्ञ तक): 'A' का प्रयोग होता है।
• स्वर ध्वनि (Vowel Sound - अ, आ, इ, ई, ए, ऐ, ओ, औ): 'An' का प्रयोग होता है।

Article Phonetic Condition (उच्चारण स्थिति) SSC High-Frequency Words List हिंदी उच्चारण एवं कारण
Use of 'A' Words beginning with a Consonant Sound a boy, a child, a book, a student, a pen सामान्य व्यंजन ध्वनि।
Use of 'A' (Tricky!) Words beginning with Vowels (E, U, O) but pronounced with a Consonant Sound ('य' / 'व') a university, a European, a unique book, a uniform, a universal problem, a one-eyed man, a one-rupee note, a unit, a union • University, European, Uniform: शुरुआत स्वर (E/U) से है, पर उच्चारण 'यू' (य) से शुरू होता है → A!
• One-eyed, One-rupee: उच्चारण 'वन' (व) से शुरू होता है → A!
Use of 'An' Words beginning with a natural Vowel Sound an elephant, an apple, an umbrella, an orange, an idiot स्वाभाविक स्वर ध्वनि (अ, इ, उ, ऐ)।
Use of 'An' (Silent 'h') Words beginning with a Mute (Silent) 'h' where the vowel is pronounced an hour, an heir, an heiress, an honest man, an honorary post, an honourable person, an hourly visit यहाँ 'H' मौन (silent) रहता है और उच्चारण स्वर 'आ' / 'ऑ' से होता है: an hour (आवर), an heir (एयर = उत्तराधिकारी)।
Use of 'An' (Acronyms / Abbreviations) Consonants pronounced with an initial vowel sound (ए, ऐ): F, H, L, M, N, R, S, X an M.P., an M.L.A., an S.P., an S.D.O., an F.I.R., an X-ray, an LL.B. student, an N.C.C. officer, an R.T.C. • M = 'एम' (स्वर ध्वनि 'ए' से शुरू) → an M.P.
• S = 'एस' (स्वर ध्वनि 'ए' से शुरू) → an S.P.
• L = 'एल' → an LL.B.
• F = 'एफ़' → an F.I.R.
🔥 Spotting Error Examples (A vs An)

❌ Incorrect: He is a M.L.A. of our constituency.
✓ Correct: He is an M.L.A. of our constituency. [M = 'एम' → स्वर ध्वनि!]

❌ Incorrect: It is an unique piece of art.
✓ Correct: It is a unique piece of art. [Unique = 'यूनिक' → व्यंजन ध्वनि!]

❌ Incorrect: I met an European lady in Agra.
✓ Correct: I met a European lady in Agra. [European = 'यूरोपियन' → व्यंजन ध्वनि!]

❌ Incorrect: He has been waiting for a hour.
✓ Correct: He has been waiting for an hour. [Hour = 'आवर' → Silent 'h'!]

3. Complete Uses of Indefinite Articles (A / An) ('A' और 'An' के संपूर्ण विशिष्ट प्रयोग)

Special Use / Condition Rule Explanation Example Sentences
1. Mentioned for First Time जब किसी एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा का पहली बार सामान्य रूप में उल्लेख हो। • A beggar came to my door.
• Twelve inches make a foot.
2. Representative of a Class जब कोई एकवचन संज्ञा अपनी पूरी जाति या प्रजाति का प्रतिनिधित्व करे (in the sense of 'any'). • A cow is a useful animal. (गाय उपयोगी पशु है)
• A son should be obedient. (बेटे को आज्ञाकारी होना चाहिए)
• A rose is a sweet flower.
3. Proper Noun Made Common जब किसी व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा का प्रयोग उसके विशिष्ट गुण/अवगुण को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाए। • He is a Shylock. (वह एक क्रूर कंजूस है)
• He is a Vikramaditya known for fairness.
4. Price, Rate, Speed & Ratio प्रति (per) की दर या गति दर्शाने के लिए। • Sugar sells at fifty rupees a kilo.
• He drives at 80 kilometres an hour.
• Brush your teeth twice a day.
5. Exclamations with 'What' / 'How' विस्मयादिबोधक वाक्यों में एकवचन संज्ञा से पहले। • What a pretty girl!
• What a hot day!
• How fine a day! (विशेषण के बाद)
6. Position with Adverbs (so, too, such, quite) • such / quite / rather / what + a/an + Noun
• so / too / as / how + Adjective + a/an + Noun		 • He is such a nice man.
• It is quite an interesting story.
• She is too weak a student to pass.
• She is as intelligent a student as her brother.
7. Verbs Used as Nouns जब कोई क्रिया संज्ञा की तरह इस्तेमाल की जाए। • Go for a walk / for a swim / for a drive.
• Have a talk / have a rest / have a headache.
8. Fixed Idiomatic Phrases निश्चित मुहावरेदार वाक्यांशों में अनिवार्य रूप से 'a/an' लगता है। in a hurry, make a noise, tell a lie, take a fancy, feel a shame, a pity, at a loss, in a nutshell

4. Complete Uses of Definite Article 'The' (निश्चित उपपद 'The' के संपूर्ण 26 नियम)

The Definite Article 'The' is used to refer to a specific, unique, or previously identified noun. Study these high-frequency examination categories:

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: निश्चित उपपद 'The' का प्रयोग किसी खास, अद्वितीय या पूर्व-परिचित संज्ञा से पहले होता है। SSC में पूछे जाने वाले प्रमुख वर्ग:
Category Where 'The' is Compulsory Critical Exceptions (जहाँ 'The' वर्जित है ❌)
1. Mountain Ranges & Island Groups पर्वतमालाओं और द्वीपसमूहों के नाम से पहले:
The Himalayas, The Alps, The Andes, The Andaman and Nicobar Islands		 ⚠️ Peaks & Single Islands: पर्वत चोटियों और अकेले द्वीपों के पहले 'The' नहीं लगता!
❌ The Mount Everest → ✓ Mount Everest
❌ The Aravali → ✓ Aravali (पर्वतमाला नहीं, चोटी/श्रेणी रूप)
2. Water Bodies (Rivers, Seas, Oceans, Gulfs) The Ganga, The Yamuna, The Nile, The Red Sea, The Indian Ocean, The Persian Gulf झील (Lake) के नाम से पहले 'the' नहीं लगता: Lake Superior, Dal Lake.
3. Unique Celestial Bodies सृष्टि की अद्वितीय वस्तुओं से पहले:
The Sun, The Moon, The Earth, The Sky, The Equator		 ग्रहों के नाम साधारणतः बिना article के आते हैं: Mars, Venus, Jupiter.
4. Holy Scriptures & Newspapers The Gita, The Ramayana, The Quran, The Bible, The Times of India, The Hindu यदि लेखक/कवि का नाम जुड़ा हो, तो 'the' नहीं लगता:
❌ The Valmiki's Ramayana → ✓ Valmiki's Ramayana.
5. Descriptive Geographical Names संघ, गणतंत्र या बहुवचन वाले देशों के नाम:
The USA, The UK, The USSR, The United Arab Emirates, The Netherlands, The Sudan, The Philippines		 साधारण देशों के नाम से पहले नहीं लगता: India, China, America, France.
6. Historical Monuments & Dynasties The Taj Mahal, The Red Fort, The Gupta Dynasty, The Middle Ages, The French Revolution निजी भवनों के नाम से पहले नहीं लगता।
7. Trains, Ships & Aeroplanes The Rajdhani Express, The Titanic, The Shatabdi वाहन निर्माता के नाम से पहले नहीं (Boeing 747).
8. Adjective as a Plural Noun जब Adjective पूरे वर्ग का बोध कराए:
The rich (अमीर लोग), The poor (गरीब लोग), The blind, The elderly		 इनके साथ कभी '-s' नहीं लगता (The poors ❌) और हमेशा Plural Verb आती है!
9. Musical Instruments वाद्य-यंत्र बजाने के संदर्भ में:
• He plays the flute.
• She is fond of playing the harmonium.		 यदि केवल वस्तु के रूप में खरीदा जाए: He bought a flute (यहाँ 'a' आएगा).
10. Double Comparatives (जितना... उतना) समानांतर तुलना में दोनों तरफ 'The' आता है:
• The higher you go, the colder it is.
• The sooner, the better.		 एक तरफ भी 'The' छोड़ना एरर है!
11. Choice Between Two (दो में से चुनाव) जब दो में से एक का चुनाव हो (Comparative Degree + of the two):
• She is the weaker of the two sisters.
• Who is the more beautiful of the two girls?		 सामान्य तुलना में 'than' के साथ 'the' नहीं लगता: She is weaker than her sister.
12. Metaphorical Comparison of Proper Nouns जब किसी व्यक्ति को किसी ऐतिहासिक हस्ती की उपमा दी जाए:
• Kalidas is the Shakespeare of India.
• Surdas is the Milton of India.		 यहाँ 'the' का अर्थ उपमा या सर्वोच्च प्रतिष्ठा है।
13. Direction & Physical Positions • the East, the West, the North
• the top, the bottom, the centre, the back		 यदि दिशा के साथ राज्य/स्थान का नाम जुड़ा हो तो नहीं लगता: Northern India, West Bengal.
14. Rates & Units of Measurement माप की इकाई बताने के लिए:
• Cloth is sold by the metre.
• Eggs are sold by the dozen.		 लेकिन दर बताने के लिए: Fifty rupees a dozen.
15. Inventions & Media आविष्कार के रूप में:
The telephone, The wheel, The radio		 ⚠️ Television Trap: आविष्कार के रूप में 'The television'; लेकिन टीवी सेट देखने के अर्थ में 'the' नहीं लगता: He was watching television ✓.
16. Organs of Government & Armed Forces The Judiciary, The Legislature, The Army, The Air Force, The Police संसद के नाम से पहले 'the' नहीं लगता: Parliament (The Parliament ❌).

5. Omission of Articles (Zero Article - कहाँ आर्टिकल नहीं लगेगा) (आर्टिकल का निषेध (Zero Article के महत्वपूर्ण नियम))

In SSC error-spotting, questions on superfluous articles (inserting 'the' where it should not be) are just as frequent as missing articles. Memorize these rules:

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: कहाँ आर्टिकल नहीं लगेगा, यह जानना सबसे अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि अनावश्यक 'the' लगाना SSC का सबसे पसंदीदा एरर है:

(A) Primary Purpose of School, College, Hospital, Temple, Prison, Bed

विशेष नियम (Primary Purpose vs Other Purpose):
जब school, college, university, church, temple, mosque, hospital, prison, court, bed, sea का प्रयोग उनके मूल उद्देश्य (Primary Purpose) के लिए हो (जैसे पढ़ने के लिए स्कूल, इलाज के लिए अस्पताल, पूजा के लिए मंदिर, सोने के लिए बिस्तर, सज़ा काटने के लिए जेल), तो इनके पहले कोई आर्टिकल नहीं लगता!
• परंतु यदि कोई व्यक्ति किसी अन्य कार्य (मुश्किलाकात, मरम्मत, दौरा) के लिए जाए, तो 'The' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है:

Primary Purpose (Zero Article - No 'The') Secondary Purpose (Building Visit - Use 'The')
• I go to school daily to study. (पढ़ने हेतु) • My father went to the school to pay fees. (फीस जमा करने)
• The patient was admitted to hospital. (इलाज हेतु) • I went to the hospital to see my injured friend. (मिलने हेतु)
• We go to temple on Mondays. (पूजा करने हेतु) • The thief was hiding behind the temple. (छिपाव स्थल)
• He was sent to prison for murder. (कैदी के रूप में) • The lawyer visited the prison to meet his client.
• I go to bed at 10 PM. (सोने के लिए) • The cat jumped onto the bed. (फर्नीचर वस्तु)

(B) Other Major Omission Rules

Category Zero Article Rule (बिना आर्टिकल) Exception / With 'The'
1. Material Nouns in General सामान्य अर्थ में धातुओं व पदार्थों से पहले नहीं लगता:
• Gold is a precious metal.
• Tea grows in India.		 विशिष्ट संदर्भ में 'The' लगता है:
• The gold of South Africa is pure.
• The tea of Assam is famous.
2. Abstract Nouns in General गुण व भाववाचक संज्ञा से पहले नहीं लगता:
• Honesty is the best policy.
• Love is a divine emotion.		 विशिष्ट व्यक्ति के गुण हेतु 'The' लगता है:
• The honesty of my father is unquestioned.
3. Languages vs Nationalities भाषा के नाम से पहले आर्टिकल नहीं लगता:
• He speaks English fluently.
• Russian is difficult.		 यदि 'the' लग जाए तो वह वहाँ के लोगों (नागरिकों) को दर्शाता है:
• The English (अंग्रेज लोग) defeated the French.
4. Modes of Transport with 'By' जब 'by' के साथ वाहन का नाम आए:
• by bus, by train, by car, by air, by sea		 ❌ by the bus / by a car (सख्त अशुद्ध!)
(लेकिन 'in a car' या 'on the bus' सही है).
5. Meals of the Day नियमित भोजन के नाम से पहले नहीं लगता:
• I take breakfast at 8 AM.
• What did you have for dinner?		 यदि विशेषण लगा हो या औपचारिक दावत हो:
• They gave us a good breakfast.
• The dinner hosted by the President.
6. Human Race (Man, Woman, Mankind) मानव जाति के व्यापक अर्थ में कोई आर्टिकल नहीं:
• Man is mortal. (मनुष्य नश्वर है)		 ❌ The man is mortal (अशुद्ध!).

6. Repetition of Articles (आर्टिकल का दोहराव) (आर्टिकल दोहराव के नियम (Joint vs Separate Entities))

Whether an article is repeated before connected nouns determines whether we are speaking about One Single Entity or Two Separate Entities:

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: जब दो पद या विशेषण 'and' से जुड़े हों, तो आर्टिकल एक बार लगेगा या दो बार—यह तय करता है कि व्यक्ति/वस्तु एक है या दो:
Construction Meaning / Entity Count Verb Used Example Sentence
Article before FIRST noun only One single person holding two posts Singular Verb The Prime Minister and President of the party is visiting today.
[एक ही व्यक्ति जो प्रधानमंत्री भी है और पार्टी अध्यक्ष भी!]
Article before BOTH nouns Two separate persons holding two posts Plural Verb The Prime Minister and the President are visiting today.
[दो अलग-अलग व्यक्ति: एक पीएम और दूसरे राष्ट्रपति!]
Two Adjectives: A + Adj1 + and + Adj2 One single object having two colors Singular She bought a black and white saree.
[एक ही साड़ी जो काली और सफेद दोनों है।]
Two Adjectives: A + Adj1 + and + a + Adj2 Two separate objects Plural She bought a black and a white saree.
[दो अलग साड़ियाँ: एक काली और एक सफेद!]
Ordinals: The + Ord1 + and + the + Ord2 Two articles → Singular Noun Plural Verb The first and the second chapter are difficult.
Ordinals: The + Ord1 + and + Ord2 One article → Plural Noun Plural Verb The first and second chapters are difficult.

7. SSC CGL/CHSL Solved Shift Questions (PYQ Spotting Errors) (विगत वर्षों के हल प्रश्न (विस्तृत व्याख्या सहित))

Q1. SSC CGL Tier-1 Shift Question

Spot the error in the sentence:
"The higher we climb / up the mountain / colder we feel / No error."

Answer & Detailed Explanation:
👉 Error is in Part 3. Parallel comparison (समानांतर तुलना) में दोनों तरफ 'The + Comparative Degree' आता है। अतः 'colder' से पहले the अनिवार्य है।
✓ Correct Sentence: "The higher we climb up the mountain, the colder we feel."

Q2. SSC CHSL Tier-1 Shift Question

Spot the error in the sentence:
"My elder sister / went to the hospital / to undergo a surgery / No error."

Answer & Detailed Explanation:
👉 Error is in Part 2. जब कोई व्यक्ति अस्पताल में इलाज या सर्जरी कराने (Primary Purpose) जाता है, तो 'hospital' के पहले 'the' नहीं लगता।
✓ Correct Sentence: "My elder sister went to hospital to undergo a surgery."

Q3. SSC CPO Tier-1 Shift Question

Spot the error in the sentence:
"He travels / to office daily / by the bus / No error."

Answer & Detailed Explanation:
👉 Error is in Part 3. साधन बताने वाले 'by' के बाद सीधे वाहन का नाम आता है, बीच में कोई आर्टिकल नहीं आता (by bus, by train, by car).
✓ Correct Sentence: "He travels to office daily by bus."

Q4. SSC CGL Tier-2 Mains Question

Spot the error in the sentence:
"The Mount Everest is / the highest peak in the world / situated in the Himalayas / No error."

Answer & Detailed Explanation:
👉 Error is in Part 1. पर्वत चोटियों (Mountain Peaks) के नाम से पहले 'the' नहीं लगता। 'The' केवल पर्वतमालाओं (Ranges) से पहले लगता है जैसे 'The Himalayas'।
✓ Correct Sentence: "Mount Everest is the highest peak in the world situated in the Himalayas."

8. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) (अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न)

Q1. Why do we say 'a university' but 'an umbrella'?
Ans: 'University' begins with a consonant sound ('yu' - य), so it takes 'a'. 'Umbrella' begins with a vowel sound ('uh' - अ), so it takes 'an'.

Q2. When do we use 'The' before names of countries?
Ans: 'The' is used only before countries that contain words like Kingdom, States, Republic, Union (e.g. The USA, The UK, The UAE) or have plural geographical names (e.g. The Netherlands, The Philippines).

Q3. Why does 'school' not take 'the' in 'I go to school'?
Ans: When institutions like school, college, hospital, temple, and prison are visited for their fundamental purpose (study, prayer, medical care), no article is used.

title: Active & Passive Voice (वाच्य)
hindi_title: वाच्य (Voice): Active और Passive Voice के नियम
excerpt: Active and Passive Voice rules: Tense transformation tables, modals, imperative sentences, bare infinitive rules, fixed prepositions, and solved PYQs.
seo_description: Active and Passive Voice rules: Tense transformation tables, modals, imperative sentences, bare infinitive rules, fixed prepositions, and solved PYQs.
content:
1 Voice क्या है? • Active vs Passive Voice की पहचान

क्रिया (Verb) का वह रूप जो यह व्यक्त करता है कि कर्ता (Subject) स्वयं कोई कार्य कर रहा है, या कर्ता पर ही कार्य का प्रभाव पड़ रहा है।

Active Voice (कर्तृवाच्य)

जब वाक्य का आरम्भ कर्ता (Subject / Doer) से होता है, अर्थात् कर्ता कार्य को करता है।

  • • They will do the work. (वे काम करेंगे — Doer 'They' पहले है)
  • • The teacher has punished the boy. (अध्यापक ने लड़के को दंडित किया)
Passive Voice (कर्मवाच्य)

जब वाक्य का आरम्भ कर्म (Object / Receiver) से होता है, अर्थात् कार्य कर्म पर किया जाता है।

  • • The work will be done by them. (काम उनके द्वारा किया जाएगा)
  • • The boy has been punished by the teacher. (लड़का दंडित किया गया)

Passive Voice की अनिवार्य शर्त: सिर्फ सकर्मक क्रिया (Transitive Verb) का ही Passive बनता है!

जब क्रिया का फल किसी Object (कर्म) पर पड़ता है, तभी वह Transitive होती है। यदि वाक्य में Object ही नहीं है (Intransitive Verb), तो Passive Voice नहीं बन सकता।

Transitive Verbs (Passive संभव):

He writes a letter. → यहाँ writes का सीधा असर a letter पर है। अतः Passive: A letter is written by him.

Intransitive Verbs (Passive असंभव):

Jaya came here. / Father is going out. → come, go, sleep, die, arrive अकर्मक क्रियाएँ हैं। इनके बाद कोई Object नहीं होता (here/out Adverbs हैं)। अतः इनका Passive नहीं बनता।

2 Passive Voice का सार्वभौमिक सूत्र (Master Transformation Formula)

अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में किसी भी Active वाक्य को Passive में बदलते समय 3 बुनियादी बदलाव होते हैं:

Master Rule of Passive Voice
Active:   Subject + Verb + Object
Passive: Object + Helping Verb (Form of 'To Be') + V3 (Past Participle) + by + Subject
नियम 1: अदला-बदली Active का Object → Passive का Subject बनता है। Active का Subject → 'by' के बाद Objective Case (me, him, her, them, us) में आता है।
नियम 2: सदा V3 रूप Passive Voice में मुख्य क्रिया (Main Verb) सदा अपनी तीसरी अवस्था (V3 - Past Participle) में ही रहती है।
नियम 3: 'To Be' का चुनाव Tense का निर्धारण सिर्फ 'To Be' के रूप से होता है: be, is/am/are, was/were, being, been।
Form of 'TO BE' Tense / Verb Construction Passive Verb Structure उदाहरण
be Infinitive, Modals, Future Indefinite will/can/must + be + V3 It can be done.
is, am, are Present Indefinite (Simple Present) is/am/are + V3 A song is sung.
was, were Past Indefinite (Simple Past) was/were + V3 The letter was written.
been Perfect Tenses (Present, Past, Future) has/have/had/will have + been + V3 He has been punished.
being Continuous Tenses (Present & Past) is/am/are/was/were + being + V3 A car is being driven.

3 Tense-wise Active to Passive Transformation Chart (सभी 8 काल)

कुल 12 Tenses में से सिर्फ 8 Tenses का Passive Voice बनता है। 4 Tenses (Future Continuous और तीनों Perfect Continuous) का Passive Voice सामान्यतः नहीं बिनाया जाता।

Tense Active Voice Structure Passive Voice Structure Active Example Passive Transformation
Simple Present S + V1 / V1+s/es + O O + is/am/are + V3 + by S She writes letters. Letters are written by her.
Present Cont. S + is/am/are + V1+ing + O O + is/am/are + being + V3 + by S They are playing football. Football is being played by them.
Present Perfect S + has/have + V3 + O O + has/have + been + V3 + by S The teacher has punished him. He has been punished by the teacher.
Simple Past S + V2 + O O + was/were + V3 + by S He killed the snake. The snake was killed by him.
Past Cont. S + was/were + V1+ing + O O + was/were + being + V3 + by S She was driving a car. A car was being driven by her.
Past Perfect S + had + V3 + O O + had + been + V3 + by S They had completed the task. The task had been completed by them.
Simple Future S + will/shall + V1 + O O + will/shall + be + V3 + by S They will do the work. The work will be done by them.
Future Perfect S + will/shall have + V3 + O O + will/shall have been + V3 + by S He will have won the race. The race will have been won by him.
इन 4 Tenses का Passive Voice परीक्षा में नहीं बनता:

1. Present Perfect Continuous  |  2. Past Perfect Continuous  |  3. Future Perfect Continuous  |  4. Future Continuous.
(कारण: इनमें 'been being' या 'be being' जैसी ध्वनियाँ व्याकरणिक रूप से भद्दी व अनावश्यक मानी जाती हैं)।

4 Modals, Infinitives एवं Gerunds का Passive Voice

SSC परीक्षाओं में सामान्य Tense के स्थान पर Modals और Infinitives से प्रश्न सबसे अधिक पूछे जाते हैं।

A. Modal Auxiliaries

Formula: Modal + be + V3

Active: We can win this match.
Passive: This match can be won by us.
Active: You must obey traffic rules.
Passive: Traffic rules must be obeyed.
Active: The judge should punish criminals.
Passive: Criminals should be punished.

B. Infinitives (To + V1)

Formula: to be + V3

Active: She is to write a letter.
Passive: A letter is to be written by her.
Active: They were to complete the work.
Passive: The work was to be completed.
Active: There is nothing to lose.
Passive: There is nothing to be lost.

C. Gerund / Participle (V1+ing)

Formula: being + V3

Active: I remember my mother taking me to doctor.
Passive: I remember being taken to doctor by my mother.
Active: I found his friends laughing at him.
Passive: I found him being laughed at by his friends.

5 Imperative Sentences (आज्ञा, अनुरोध, सलाह) के नियम

Imperative वाक्यों में कर्ता 'You' छिपा रहता है। भाव (Sense) के अनुसार इनके अलग-अलग सूत्र होते हैं:

1. Command / Order (With Object) Let + Object + be + V3

यदि वाक्य में कर्म (Object) मौजूद हो, तो वाक्य 'Let' से शुरू होता है:

  • • Bring a book. → Let a book be brought.
  • • Turn Payal out. → Let Payal be turned out.
  • • Close the door. → Let the door be closed.
2. Command / Order (Without Object) You are ordered to + V1

यदि अकर्मक क्रिया हो (कोई Object न हो), तो 'You are ordered to' का प्रयोग करें:

  • • Go out at once. → You are ordered to go out at once.
  • • Don't stay here. → You are ordered not to stay here.
3. Advice / Moral Duty (सलाह / कर्तव्य) Object + should be + V3

सलाह या कर्तव्य के भाव में 'Let' के स्थान पर 'should be' श्रेष्ठ माना जाता है:

  • • Obey parents. → Parents should be obeyed.
  • • Help the poor. → The poor should be helped.
  • • Listen to me. → I should be listened to.
  • • Prepare for war. → You should be prepared for war.
4. Request & 'Let Us' (सुझाव) You are requested / It is suggested

'Please / Kindly' हटने पर 'You are requested to' लगता है:

  • • Please come soon. → You are requested to come soon.
  • • Let me play here. → I may be allowed to play here.
  • • Let us stay here. → It is suggested that we should stay here.
  • • Let us sleep here. → It is suggested that we should sleep here.

6 SSC के 7 सबसे घातक Traps (विशेष अपवाद एवं नियम)

Tier-1 और Tier-2 में 80% गलतियाँ इन्हीं 7 बिंदुओं पर होती हैं:

Trap 1: 'By' के स्थान पर अन्य Prepositions लेने वाली क्रियाएँ (Fixed Prepositions)

कुछ क्रियाएँ Passive Voice में कर्ता के पहले by नहीं लेतीं, बल्कि अपना निश्चित Preposition लेती हैं:

Surprise / Shock → AT Active: Her sudden arrival surprised everyone.
Passive: Everybody was surprised at her sudden arrival. (not by)
Know / Marry → TO Active: I know him.
Passive: He is known to me. (not by me)
Pleased / Satisfied → WITH Active: His work pleased the boss.
Passive: The boss was pleased with his work.
Contain / Embody → IN Active: This box contains ten books.
Passive: Ten books are contained in this box.
Annoy (Person) → WITH Active: Ram annoyed Shyam.
Passive: Shyam was annoyed with Ram.
Annoy (Action) → AT Active: His behaviour annoyed us.
Passive: We were annoyed at his behaviour.

Trap 2: Bare Infinitives → Passive में 'To + V1' बन जाते हैं!

make, hear, see, bid, watch के बाद Active Voice में बिना 'to' के $V_1$ (Bare Infinitive) आता है, लेकिन Passive Voice में अनिवार्य रूप से 'to' जुड़ जाता है।

Make:

Active: I made her sing a song.
Passive: She was made to sing a song.

Bid:

Active: I bade him go.
Passive: He was bidden to go.

अपवाद (LET):

'Let' के साथ Passive में भी 'to' नहीं लगता!
Active: She let me go.
Passive: I was let go by her. (not let to go)

Trap 3: Phrasal Verbs का Preposition कभी न छोड़ें!

जब क्रिया के साथ Preposition जुड़ा हो (जैसे look after, laugh at, look down upon), तो Passive में 'by' आने के बाद भी क्रिया का Preposition कायम रहता है:

• Active: Mothers look after their children. → Passive: Children are looked after by their mothers.

• Active: You should not look down upon the poor. → Passive: The poor should not be looked down upon by you.

Trap 4: अस्पष्ट कर्ता (Vague Agent) का लोप एवं Nobody/None का प्रयोग

(a) यदि कर्ता somebody, someone, people, they, police जैसा सामान्य या स्वतः स्पष्ट हो, तो Passive में by somebody हटा दिया जाता है:
• Active: Somebody has picked my pocket. → Passive: My pocket has been picked. (not by somebody)
• Active: They will declare the result soon. → Passive: The result will be declared soon.

(b) यदि Active वाक्य Nobody / None से शुरू हो, तो Passive में not लग जाता है:
• Active: Nobody can change destiny. → Passive: Destiny cannot be changed.
• Active: None saw her in the parlour. → Passive: She was not seen in the parlour.

Trap 5: That-Clause तथा दो कर्मों (Two Objects) वाले वाक्य

That-Clause (It is + V3 + that...): Active: People consider that he is honest.
Passive: It is considered that he is honest.

Active: We hope that he will pass.
Passive: It is hoped that he will pass.
दो कर्म (Indirect & Direct Objects): Active: He gave me a book.
Passive (a): I was given a book by him. (सजीव कर्म से बिनाना अधिक स्वाभाविक है)
Passive (b): A book was given to me by him.

7 SSC पिछले वर्षों के हल प्रश्न (PYQs with Step-by-Step Traps)

SSC CGL, CHSL एवं CPO में बार-बार पूछे गए वास्तविक प्रश्नों का सटीक विश्लेषण:

SSC CGL Tier-1 Fixed Preposition Trap

Q1: Her sudden arrival surprised everyone. Change into Passive Voice.

(A) Everyone was surprised by her sudden arrival.

(B) Everyone was surprised at her sudden arrival.

(C) Everyone had surprised at her sudden arrival.

(D) Everyone was surprising her sudden arrival.

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: 'Surprised' किसी घटना या आगमन पर होने पर Preposition 'at' लेता है, न कि 'by'। अतः surprised at सही है।
SSC CGL Tier-2 Bare Infinitive Trap

Q2: The teacher made him clean the blackboard.

(A) He was made clean the blackboard by the teacher.

(B) He was made to clean the blackboard by the teacher.

(C) He had been made cleaning the blackboard.

(D) He was made being cleaned the blackboard.

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: Verb 'make' के बाद Active में Bare Infinitive (clean) आता है, लेकिन Passive Voice में अनिवार्य रूप से 'to + V1' (to clean) आता है।
SSC CHSL Imperative Advice Trap

Q3: Obey your parents.

(A) Let your parents be obeyed.

(B) Your parents should be obeyed.

(C) You are ordered to obey parents.

(D) Parents must obey you.

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: जब वाक्य में नैतिक कर्तव्य या सलाह (Moral Duty) का भाव हो, तो 'Let' के स्थान पर 'should be + V3' का प्रयोग सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त माना जाता है।
SSC CPO Phrasal Verb Trap

Q4: They are looking after the orphans.

(A) The orphans are looked after by them.

(B) The orphans are being looked after by them.

(C) The orphans have been looked after.

(D) The orphans are being looked by them.

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: Present Continuous होने के कारण 'are being looked' आएगा और Phrasal verb का Preposition 'after' अनिवार्य रूप से लगा रहेगा (looked after by them)।

अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल (Voice FAQs)

Q1. क्या सभी वाक्यों का Passive Voice बिनाया जा सकता है? ↓

नहीं। केवल सकर्मक क्रियाओं (Transitive Verbs — जिनके साथ Object हो) का ही Passive बनता है। अकर्मक क्रियाओं (Intransitive Verbs जैसे go, come, sleep, die) का कोई Object न होने के कारण Passive Voice नहीं बनता।

Q2. Active Voice से Passive Voice बिनाते समय Tense बदलता है या नहीं? ↓

बिल्कुल नहीं! यह Voice और Narration (Direct-Indirect) का सबसे बड़ा अंतर है। Narration में Present Past में बदल जाता है, लेकिन Voice में Tense समान रहता है (Present Indefinite का उत्तर Present में ही रहेगा, सिर्फ 'is/am/are + V3' लग जाता है)।

Q3. 'by + subject' कब छोड़ दिया जाता है (Omit)? ↓

जब कर्ता अस्पष्ट (vague) हो या कार्य करने वाले का उल्लेख करना अनावश्यक हो — जैसे someone, somebody, anyone, people, they, the police। उदाहरण के लिए: The thief was caught (by the police छोड़ दिया जाता है)।

title: Question Tags (प्रश्नवाचक पूँछ)
hindi_title: Question Tags के नियम एवं Contraction Tables
excerpt: Question Tags rules: Contracted auxiliaries table, aren't I rule, negative words, indefinite pronouns, and solved PYQs.
seo_description: Question Tags rules: Contracted auxiliaries table, aren't I rule, negative words, indefinite pronouns, and solved PYQs.

1 Question Tag की परिभाषा एवं आधारभूत संरचना (Structure)

Question Tag अपने आप में पूर्ण प्रश्न नहीं होते, बल्कि कथन की पुष्टि (Confirmation) के लिए अंत में जोड़े जाते हैं।

The Golden Rule of Question Tags
1. Positive Statement → Negative Tag Statement (+) , [Auxiliary + n't + Pronoun] ?
• We are reading, aren't we? (हम पढ़ रहे हैं, है न?) • You will do this job, won't you?
2. Negative Statement → Positive Tag Statement (-) , [Auxiliary + Pronoun] ?
• She is not working, is she? (वह काम नहीं कर रही, है न?) • They had not gone there, had they?
अल्पविराम (Comma): मुख्य वाक्य और Tag के बीच हमेशा कॉमा (,) आता है।
Small Letter: Question Tag कभी Capital Letter से शुरू नहीं होता (छोटा अक्षर)।
सदा Pronoun: The subject of a tag is always a pronoun (Tag का Subject कभी Noun नहीं हो सकता, केवल Pronoun होता है)।

2 Contracted Auxiliaries Master Table (संक्षिप्त रूपों की सूची)

Negative Tag में कभी भी 'Auxiliary + not' अलग-अलग नहीं लिखा जाता। हमेशा Contracted Form (संक्षिप्त रूप) का ही प्रयोग होता है:

Full Form Contracted Full Form Contracted Full Form Contracted
do + not don't does + not doesn't did + not didn't
is + not isn't are + not aren't am + not aren't I? (Trap!)
was + not wasn't were + not weren't has + not hasn't
have + not haven't had + not hadn't will + not won't (Trap!)
shall + not shan't (Trap!) can + not can't could + not couldn't
may + not mayn't might + not mightn't must + not mustn't
ought + not oughtn't need + not needn't dare + not daren't

SSC Super Trap: 'amn't I?' अंग्रेजी में नहीं होता!

अंग्रेजी भाषा में amn't कोई शब्द नहीं है। अतः I am का Negative Tag सदा aren't I? बनता है।
• I am right, aren't I? (Correct — 'amn't I?' बिल्कुल गलत है)
• लेकिन ध्यान दें: यदि वाक्य Negative हो, तो Positive Tag में सामान्य am I? ही आएगा:
• I am not happy, am I? (Correct)

3 Question Tags के सभी 13 मुख्य नियम (13 Core Rules)

SSC द्वारा पूछे जाने वाले हर एक नियम का नियमवार विश्लेषण:

Rule 1 & 2: Tag का कर्ता हमेशा Pronoun होगा & Small Letter से शुरू होगा

Tag में कभी भी Noun (संज्ञा) नहीं आ सकता। Noun के लिंग, वचन व पुरुष के अनुसार उचित Pronoun (he, she, it, they) का ही प्रयोग होता है।

• Ram is doing maths, isn't he? (isn't Ram गलत है)

• Parul has not eaten, has she? (has Parul गलत है)

• The boys were playing, weren't they? (Boys → they)

• The dog was barking, wasn't it? (Dog → it)

Rule 4: यदि Statement में कोई Auxiliary Verb न हो → Do / Does / Did का प्रयोग

Simple Present और Simple Past के सकारात्मक वाक्यों में Helping Verb नहीं होती। ऐसे वाक्यों में क्रिया के अनुसार don't / doesn't / didn't लगाया जाता है:

V1 → don't • You enjoyed that, didn't you? (V2)
• We love it, don't we? (V1)
V1+s/es → doesn't • She works in sales, doesn't she?
• It looks perfect there, doesn't it?
V2 (Past) → didn't • We went there last year, didn't we?
• He broke the glass, didn't he?

Rule 5: नकारात्मक शब्द (Negative Words) वाले वाक्य → Positive Tag

SSC Frequent Trap

यदि वाक्य में seldom, rarely, hardly, scarcely, barely, neither, none, nobody, nothing, few, little जैसे नकारात्मक शब्द हों, तो वाक्य का अर्थ नकारात्मक हो जाता है — अतः इनका Tag सदा Positive (सकारात्मक) बनेगा:

• He seldom comes here, does he? (doesn't he गलत है)
• Barking dogs seldom bite, do they? (Dogs = Plural, bite = V1)
• She has little knowledge of English, has she? (Little = Negative)
• Trap Alert: She has a little knowledge, hasn't she? ('a little' और 'a few' सकारात्मक होते हैं)

Rule 6 & 7: This, That, These, Those, There, One का Tag Subject

This / That → IT
• This is your pen, isn't it?
• That was not fair, was it?
These / Those → THEY
• These are lovely flowers, aren't they?
• Those boys are naughty, aren't they?
There → THERE (बदलता नहीं)
• There is no water, is there?
• There are many boys, aren't there?
One → ONE (बदलता नहीं)
• One can do this, can't one?
• One should obey rules, shouldn't one?

Rule 8: Everyone, Somebody, Nobody → Tag Subject 'THEY' + Plural Verb

#1 Favorite SSC Trap

यदि वाक्य का कर्ता everyone, everybody, someone, somebody, no one, nobody, anyone, anybody हो, तो Tag का कर्ता THEY बनता है। चूँकि 'they' बहुवचन है, इसलिए Tag की Auxiliary Verb भी Plural (बहुवचन) हो जाती है:

• Everyone has come, haven't they?   (hasn't they बिल्कुल गलत है!)
• Somebody was making noise, weren't they?   (wasn't they गलत है, were आएगा!)
• Nobody has called, have they?   (Nobody नकारात्मक है, अतः Positive Tag 'have they')

Rule 9: Everything, Something, Nothing, Anything → Tag Subject 'IT'

वस्तुओं के लिए प्रयुक्त Indefinite Pronouns के लिए Tag का Subject IT होता है (एकवचन क्रिया के साथ):

  • • Everything is clear, isn't it?
  • • Something is missing, isn't it?
  • • Nothing was left, was it? (Nothing = Negative, अतः Positive Tag)

Rule 10: All of us, None of you, Neither of them वाले वाक्य

'Of' के बाद आने वाले Objective Pronoun के Subjective Form के अनुसार Tag का Subject तय होता है:

...of us → WE
All of us were present, weren't we?
Neither of us went there, did we?
...of you → YOU
None of you attended the class, did you?
Some of you can dance, can't you?
...of them → THEY
Neither of them is guilty, are they?
All of them laughed, didn't they?

Rule 11, 12 & 13: Imperative Sentences & 'Let' वाले वाक्य

A. Let us / Let's (प्रस्ताव / सुझाव) → shall we? • Let us go for a walk, shall we?
• Let's dance together, shall we?
B. Let him / her / them / Payal (अनुमति) → will you? • Let him dance, will you?
• Let them play, will you?
C. सामान्य Imperative (Order / Request) → will you? / won't you? • Open the door, will you? (or won't you?)
• Don't make noise, will you? (नकारात्मक Imperative में सदा Positive Tag 'will you')
D. झुंझलाहट या नाराजगी (Annoyance / Impatience) → can't you? • Shut your mouth, can't you?
• Keep quiet, can't you?

4 SSC Previous Year Questions (PYQs with Explanations)

SSC CGL, CHSL एवं CPO में बार-बार पूछे गए Question Tag प्रश्न:

SSC CGL Tier-1 aren't I? Trap

Q1: I am doing my job honestly, __________?

(A) amn't I

(B) aren't I

(C) don't I

(D) isn't it

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में 'amn't I' जैसा कोई शब्द नहीं है। I am का Negative Tag सदा aren't I होता है।
SSC CHSL Subject-Verb Agreement Trap

Q2: Everyone has submitted the assignment, __________?

(A) hasn't he

(B) hasn't they

(C) haven't they

(D) doesn't he

उत्तर: (C) • Explanation: 'Everyone' के लिए Tag का Pronoun they होता है। Pronoun 'they' बहुवचन होने के कारण Verb 'has' बदलकर have हो जाएगी → haven't they?
SSC CPO Negative Adverb Trap

Q3: He seldom visits his hometown, __________?

(A) doesn't he

(B) does he

(C) isn't he

(D) didn't he

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: 'Seldom' एक नकारात्मक Adverb है, जिससे वाक्य का अर्थ Negative हो जाता है। अतः Tag सकारात्मक (Positive) होगा → does he?
SSC CGL Tier-1 Let's Suggestion

Q4: Let us organize a picnic, __________?

(A) will you

(B) shall we

(C) shouldn't we

(D) won't you

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: जब वाक्य 'Let us' (या Let's) से शुरू हो, तो वह प्रस्ताव या सुझाव व्यक्त करता है और उसका Tag निश्चित रूप से shall we? होता है।

अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल (Question Tag FAQs)

Q1. क्या Question Tag में Noun (जैसे Ram, Sita, Boys) आ सकता है? ↓

नहीं, कभी नहीं। Question Tag का Subject हमेशा एक उपयुक्त Pronoun (he, she, it, they, we, you, I, one, there) ही होता है।

Q2. 'Few' और 'A few' में Question Tag का क्या अंतर है? ↓

Few का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' (Negative) होता है, अतः इसके साथ Positive Tag आता है (e.g., Few people came, did they?)। जबकि A few का अर्थ 'कुछ' (Positive) होता है, अतः इसके साथ Negative Tag आता है (e.g., A few people came, didn't they?)।

title: Modal Auxiliaries (Modals)
excerpt: Modal Auxiliaries rules: Can vs Could, May vs Might, Should vs Must vs Ought to, perfect modals, semi-modals (used to, need, dare), and solved PYQs.

1 Auxiliary Verbs के प्रकार एवं Modals की मूलभूत विशेषताएँ

अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में सहायक क्रियाएँ (Auxiliary Verbs) मुख्य रूप से दो वर्गों में विभाजित होती हैं:

(A) Primary Auxiliaries (मूल सहायक क्रियाएँ)

Be (is, am, are, was, were), Do (do, does, did), Have (has, have, had)।
ये सहायक क्रिया और मुख्य क्रिया (Main Verb) दोनों के रूप में कार्य कर सकती हैं। ये Subject के Number और Person के अनुसार बदलती हैं।

• He is playing. (Helping Verb) | He is honest. (Main Verb)

• I have done it. (Helping Verb) | I have a car. (Main Verb)

(B) Modal Auxiliaries (भावसूचक क्रियाएँ)

Can, Could, May, Might, Shall, Should, Will, Would, Must, Ought to।
ये अकेले कभी Main Verb का काम नहीं करतीं, बल्कि Main Verb की सहायता करती हैं।

• You should go for a morning walk. (सलाह / Suggestion)

• They must attend the meeting. (अनिवार्यता / Compulsion)

3 Golden Rules of Modal Verbs
Rule 1: Modal + V1 (Bare Infinitive) Modal के बाद हमेशा क्रिया का पहला रूप (V1) आता है। कभी भी V2, V3 या V1+ing सीधे नहीं आता (जैसे can do, not can did)।
Rule 2: No 's/es/ed/ing' on Modals Modals में कभी 's' या 'ed' नहीं जुड़ता (जैसे mays, cans, shoulded गलत हैं)।
Rule 3: No 'To' (Except Ought to & Used to) Modals के बाद 'to' नहीं लगता (जैसे He can to go गलत है → He can go सही है)।

2 Modals एवं उनके अर्थ / कार्यों की मास्टर तालिका (Functions Chart)

कौन-सा Modal किस भाव को व्यक्त करता है, इसका सम्पूर्ण अवलोकन:

Modal Verb मुख्य भाव / कार्य (Function) हिंदी अर्थ प्रामाणिक उदाहरण
Can Present Ability, Informal Permission, Prohibition (Cannot) सकता है (क्षमता) I can solve this puzzle.
Could Past Ability, Polite Request (Present) सका / सकता था / क्या आप... Could you lend me your pen, please?
May Formal Permission, Good Possibility (50%), Wish/Prayer, Purpose सकता है (संभावना/अनुमति) It may rain today. / May you live long!
Might Weak/Remote Possibility (20%), Past of May शायद ही (क्षीण संभावना) The sky is clear, but it might rain.
Should Advice, Moral Suggestion, Lest + Should चाहिए (सलाह) You should help the needy.
Must Compulsion, Strong Necessity, 100% Deduction/Inference अवश्य चाहिए / ज़रूर होगा He has a Mercedes; he must be rich.
Ought to Moral Duty, Social Obligation चाहिए (नैतिक कर्तव्य) We ought to respect our parents.
Would Polite Request, Past Habit, Preference (would rather), Wish करता था / चाहेंगे I would rather die than beg.
Used to Past Discontinued Habit किया करता था (अब नहीं) He used to smoke five cigarettes a day.
Need Requirement / Necessity (Modal in Negative & Interrogative) ज़रूरत / आवश्यकता You need not worry about this.
Dare Courage / Boldness (Modal in Negative & Interrogative) हिम्मत / साहस How dare you touch my phone?

3 मुख्य Modals का गहन तुलनात्मक अध्ययन (Deep Dive Analysis)

समान दिखने वाले Modals में अंतर जहाँ छात्रों सबसे अधिक भ्रमित होते हैं:

1. May vs. Might (संभावना व अनुमति में अंतर)

MAY (अच्छी संभावना • 50% Possibility): • It may rain today. (आसमान में बादल हैं, बारिश की अच्छी संभावना है)
• May I come in, sir? (औपचारिक अनुमति — Formal Permission)
• We eat so that we may live. (उद्देश्य — Purpose)
MIGHT (क्षीण संभावना • Remote Possibility): • The sky is clear, but it might rain. (मौसम साफ है, बारिश की न के बराबर संभावना है)
• She said that she might go to Delhi. (Indirect Speech में May का Past form)
• Might I ask a question? (अत्यंत संकोचपूर्ण व विनम्र प्रश्न)

2. Can vs. Could vs. Was/Were Able To (क्षमता और विशेष प्रयास में अंतर)

SSC Exam Trap: भूतकाल की सामान्य क्षमता (General Ability) के लिए could आता है, लेकिन किसी एक विशिष्ट कठिन परिस्थिति में सफल होने (Specific Achievement) के लिए was/were able to आता है:

• When I was young, I could run fast. (सामान्य क्षमता — General Ability in Past)
• The fire spread quickly, but all people were able to escape. (विशेष घटना में सफलता — 'could escape' व्याकरणिक रूप से कमजोर है)

3. Should vs. Must vs. Ought to (सलाह, मजबूरी और नैतिक कर्तव्य)

Should (सामान्य सलाह): वक्ता की व्यक्तिगत राय या सलाह:
• You should take rest now.
• You should not eat junk food.
Must (बाध्यता / पक्का निष्कर्ष): नियम, कानून या पक्का अनुमान:
• You must wear a helmet.
• Light is on; he must be inside.
Ought to (नैतिक कर्तव्य): समाज, देश या बड़ों के प्रति दायित्व:
• We ought to respect elders.
• We ought to serve our nation.

4 Perfect Modals (Modal + Have + V3) • भूतकाल की अपूर्ण घटनाएँ

जब भूतकाल की किसी ऐसी घटना की बात हो जो हो सकती थी लेकिन नहीं हुई, या पक्का अनुमान हो:

Structure अर्थ / भाव (Sense) उदाहरण वास्तविक स्थिति (Reality)
Should have + V3 करना चाहिए था (कर्तव्य अधूरा रहा) You should have studied harder. लेकिनिश्चितुमने पढ़ाई नहीं की।
Could have + V3 कर सकता था (क्षमता थी, पर नहीं किया) He could have won the match. लेकिन वह नहीं जीता।
Must have + V3 ज़रूर किया होगा (पक्का अनुमान / Strong Deduction) He must have reached Mumbai. ट्रेन 2 घंटे पहले पहुँच चुकी है।
Need not have + V3 करने की ज़रूरत नहीं थी (परंतु कर दिया) You need not have bought the umbrella. बारिश नहीं हुई, व्यर्थ में छाता खरीदा।

5 Marginal Modals / Semi-Modals (Used to, Would, Need, Dare)

ये क्रियाएँ कभी Modal तो कभी Main Verb / Adjective के रूप में कार्य करती हैं:

Used to vs. Be Used to Frequent SSC Trap
1. Subject + used to + V1 (पुरानी आदत):
• He used to play cricket daily. (पुरानी आदत, अब नहीं खेलता — V1 आएगा)
2. Subject + is/am/are/was/were + used to + V1+ing (आदी होना / Accustomed):
• He is used to working hard. ('is used to' के बाद V1+ing आता है — working, not work!)
Would के 4 मुख्य प्रयोग
• विनम्र अनुरोध: Would you please help me?
• पुरानी आदत: In winter, he would sit in the sun for hours.
• पसंद (Preference): I would rather study than sleep.
• काल्पनिक शर्त: If I were rich, I would help the poor.
Need: Modal vs. Main Verb
• Modal रूप (Negative & Question — No 'to'):
You need not go there. (need not के बाद 'to' नहीं लगता!)
Need I tell you again?
• Main Verb रूप (Takes 'to + V1' & 's/es/ed'):
He needs to buy a car. / She does not need to go.
Dare: Modal vs. Main Verb
• Modal रूप (No 'to'):
He dare not touch it. / Dare you enter the room?
(dare not के बाद 'to touch' लिखना गलत है)
• Main Verb रूप (Takes 'to + V1'):
He dares to challenge me. / He did not dare to say a word.

6 SSC के 5 सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले Modals Traps

Tier-1 और Tier-2 में इन 5 नियमों से बार-बार सीधे Error पूछे जाते हैं:

Trap 1: Lest के साथ हमेशा 'Should' आता है, और कोई 'Not' नहीं लगता!

'Lest' का अर्थ होता है "कहीं ऐसा न हो कि" (पहले से ही नकारात्मक है)। इसके साथ कभी will, would, may, might या not नहीं आता — केवल should आता है:
• Incorrect: Walk carefully lest you will fall.
• Correct: Walk carefully lest you should fall.

Trap 2: Would rather के साथ 'Than' आता है (to या then नहीं) + Bare Infinitive

पसंद (Preference) बताने के लिए would rather + V1 + than + V1 का प्रयोग होता है:
• Incorrect: I would rather starve then beg.
• Correct: I would rather starve than beg.

Trap 3: Need not और Dare not के बाद 'To' नहीं आता!

जब need और dare नकारात्मक Modal बनते हैं, तो इनके बाद Bare Infinitive आता है:
• Incorrect: You need not to worry.
• Correct: You need not worry.

7 SSC Previous Year Questions (PYQs with Explanations)

SSC CGL, CHSL एवं CPO में बार-बार पूछे गए Modals प्रश्न:

SSC CGL Tier-1 Lest + Should Trap

Q1: Make haste lest you __________ miss the train.

(A) will

(B) should

(C) might

(D) could

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: कंजंक्शन 'Lest' के बाद हमेशा केवल should का ही प्रयोग होता है (will या might गलत हैं)।
SSC CHSL Used to Trap

Q2: He is used to __________ late at night.

(A) work

(B) working

(C) worked

(D) have worked

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: जब 'used to' के पहले 'be' क्रिया (is/am/are/was/were) आती है, तो यह Adjective (आदी होना) बन जाता है और इसके बाद V1+ing (working) आता है।
SSC CPO Need Not Trap

Q3: You need not __________ any further explanation.

(A) to give

(B) give

(C) giving

(D) gave

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: 'Need not' एक Modal Auxiliary है, जिसके बाद बिना 'to' के Bare Infinitive (give) आता है।
SSC CGL Tier-2 Perfect Modal

Q4: He __________ the exam easily, but he did not study at all.

(A) can pass

(B) could have passed

(C) must pass

(D) should pass

उत्तर: (B) • Explanation: भूतकाल में क्षमता थी लेकिन कार्य नहीं हुआ — इसके लिए could have + V3 (could have passed) का प्रयोग होता है।

अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले सवाल (Modals FAQs)

Q1. क्या Modals में कभी 's' या 'ed' लग सकता है? ↓

नहीं, कभी नहीं। Modals (can, may, must, should आदि) पर Subject के Singular/Plural या Person का कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता। वे सदा अपने मूल रूप में रहते हैं।

Q2. 'Should have' और 'Must have' में क्या अंतर है? ↓

Should have + V3 का प्रयोग तब होता है जब कोई काम भूतकाल में होना चाहिए था लेकिन नहीं हुआ (जैसे 'You should have helped him')। जबकि Must have + V3 का प्रयोग भूतकाल में किसी काम के अवश्य घटित होने के पक्के अनुमान के लिए होता है (जैसे 'He must have reached home')।

title: Tenses (काल)
excerpt: Tenses rules: Formulas for all 12 tenses, stative verbs, since/for duration rules, conditional sentences, and Sequence of Tenses.
seo_description: Tenses rules: Formulas for all 12 tenses, stative verbs, since/for duration rules, conditional sentences, and Sequence of Tenses.
content:
1. What is a Tense? (Time vs State of Action) (काल (Tense) क्या है? (समय एवं कार्य की अवस्था))

A Tense is defined as that form of a verb which indicates two fundamental dimensions:

  1. The Time of an Action: When the action takes place (Present, Past, or Future).
  2. The State / Aspect of an Action: How the action exists (habitual, in progress, fully completed, or continuing over a period of time).

(A) Time of an Action:

  • Present: He goes to school. (Action relates to present time).
  • Past: He went to school. (Action relates to past time).
  • Future: He will go to school. (Action relates to future time).

(B) State / Function of an Action:

  • Habitual (Indefinite): I write letters regularly. (General habit).
  • Progressive (Continuous): I am writing a letter. (Ongoing action right now).
  • Preceding (Perfect): I have just written a letter. (Completed before now, connected to present).
  • Time Expression (Perfect Continuous): I have been writing a letter for two hours. (Began in past, still continuing).
💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

काल (Tense) क्रिया का वह रूप है जो केवल समय (Time) ही नहीं बताता, बल्कि कार्य की अवस्था (State of Action) भी दर्शाता है:

  1. काम का समय (Time): कार्य कब हुआ — वर्तमान (Present), भूतकाल (Past), या भविष्य (Future)।
  2. काम की अवस्था (State/Aspect): कार्य किस हाल में है — नियमित आदत (Habitual), चालू है (Progressive), पूरा हो चुका है (Preceding/Perfect), या किसी समय से जारी है (Time Expression)।

प्रत्येक मुख्य काल (Present, Past, Future) के चार रूप होते हैं, जिससे अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में कुल 12 Tenses बनते हैं।

⏱️ The 3 Time Frames / समय के तीन ढाँचे:
1. Point of Time: A specific exact moment (e.g., in 1947, on Monday, at 7:00 PM).
2. Period of Time: A duration without fixed start point (e.g., for ten years, from Monday to Saturday).
3. Expression of Time: Combination of point and duration (e.g., winter 1950, since childhood). 1. निश्चित बिंदु-समय (Point of Time): एक निश्चित समय बिंदु (जैसे: 1947 में, सोमवार को, सुबह 7 बजे)।
2. अवधि (Period of Time): समय का अंतराल (जैसे: 10 वर्षों के लिए, दो घंटे से)।
3. बिंदु + अवधि (Expression of Time): जैसे: 1947 की सर्दी, बचपन से।

2. The Present Indefinite Tense (Simple Present) (सामान्य वर्तमान काल (Present Indefinite Tense))

Basic Sentence Structure:

  • Affirmative: Subject + V1 (s/es with 3rd person singular) + Object
  • Negative: Subject + do/does not + V1 + Object
  • Interrogative: Do/Does + Subject + V1 + Object?

Core Usages:

  1. Habits, Customs, Routines & Repeated Actions: Expressed with Adverbs of Frequency: often, seldom, usually, never, occasionally, sometimes, normally, generally, always, frequently, rarely, daily.
    Example: "The old lady goes for a walk in the morning daily." / "Suhani always comes in time."
  2. Permanent Nature & Eternal Scientific Principles (Universal Truths):
    Example: "Water boils at 100°C." / "Rivers freeze at high altitude." / "Plants prepare their own food."
  3. Historical Present (Dramatic Narration): Used by commentators and storytellers to make past events vivid.
    Example: "Now Netaji enters and addresses the Indian soldiers."
  4. Fixed Future Arrangement / Timetable: Official schedules and planned future events.
    Example: "The Prime Minister arrives from New York tomorrow." / "He leaves for his new job next week."
💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

संरचना (Structure):

  • सकारात्मक: Subject + V1 (एकवचन कर्ता के साथ s/es) + Object (He writes / They write)
  • नकारात्मक: Subject + do/does not + V1 + Object (He does not write)

प्रमुख उपयोग:

  1. आदत, दिनचर्या व बार-बार होने वाले काम: इसके साथ Adverbs of Frequency आते हैं: often (अक्सर), seldom (शायद ही कभी), usually (आमतौर पर), never (कभी नहीं), always (हमेशा), daily (रोज़) आदि।
  2. सार्वभौमिक एवं वैज्ञानिक सत्य (Universal Truths): जो बातें हमेशा सच रहती हैं, वे सदा Present Indefinite में लिखी जाती हैं: "Water boils at 100°C." (पानी 100°C पर उबलता है)।
  3. ऐतिहासिक वर्तमान (Historical Present): बीती घटना को आँखों के सामने जीवंत सुनाने हेतु: "Now, Arjun shoots arrows at Bhishma."
  4. निश्चित भविष्य की समय-सारणी (Future Arrangement): पक्के कार्यक्रम वाले भविष्य के कार्य हेतु: "The train leaves at 5:00 PM tomorrow."

3. Present Continuous Tense & The Stative Verbs Master List (चालू वर्तमान काल एवं Stative Verbs (जो क्रियाएँ -ing में नहीं आतीं))

Structure: Subject + is/am/are + V-ing + Object

Primary Functions:

  • Action in Progress: Action happening at the moment of speaking (temporary nature): "It is raining outside." / "She is swimming in the river."
  • Near Future Definite Plan: "I am going to the cinema tomorrow." / "She is coming next week."
  • With 'Always' (Expressing Irritation / Complaint): When always is used with continuous tense, it indicates annoying behavior: "She is always nagging her children." / "He is always praising his friends."

🔥 Stative Verbs (Non-Progressive Verbs):
Certain verbs describe a state, condition, perception, or feeling rather than a dynamic physical activity. These verbs CANNOT be used in continuous (-ing) tenses under normal circumstances!

💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

संरचना: Subject + is/am/are + V-ing + Object

प्रमुख उपयोग:

  • बोलते समय जारी कार्य: "It is raining outside." (बाहर बारिश हो रही है)।
  • निकट भविष्य की पक्की योजना: "I am meeting the doctor tomorrow."
  • 'always' के साथ शिकायत या नाराजगी का भाव: "He is always praising his friends." (वह हमेशा अपने दोस्तों की तारीफ ही करता रहता है)।

🔥 Stative Verbs का सबसे बड़ा नियम:
जो क्रियाएं कोई शारीरिक काम नहीं, बल्कि अवस्था (State), इंद्रिय-बोध (Perception), स्वामित्व (Possession) या मानसिक भाव दर्शाती हैं, उनका Continuous (-ing) रूप नहीं बनता! इन्हें सदा Simple Present में लिखा जाता है।

Group (श्रेणी) Stative Verbs (प्रमुख क्रियाएँ) Incorrect (-ing) ✗ Correct Form (Simple Present) ✓
1. Verbs of Perception (इंद्रिय-बोध) see, hear, smell, taste, prefer, please We are hearing the bell. ✗ We hear the bell. ✓
2. Verbs of Thinking (सोच-विचार) think, know, mean, mind, understand, suppose I am not meaning this. ✗ I don't mean this. ✓
3. Verbs of Possession (स्वामित्व) own, have, belong, possess, contain, comprise He is owning a luxury car. ✗
This house is belonging to me. ✗		 He owns a luxury car. ✓
This house belongs to me. ✓
4. Feelings & Emotions (भाव / मनोदशा) love, hate, like, want, wish, desire, believe I am not hating him. ✗ I don't hate him. ✓
5. Verbs in General (सामान्य अवस्था) look, seem, appear, resemble, cost, require, stand The book is containing good content. ✗ The book contains good content. ✓

Stative vs Progressive: Contrast of MeaningStative बिनाम Progressive: अर्थ का महत्वपूर्ण अंतर

Some verbs can be used in the -ing form ONLY when their meaning shifts from a state to an active physical action:

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: कुछ क्रियाएं -ing में तभी आ सकती हैं जब उनका अर्थ 'अवस्था' से बदलकर 'सक्रिय कार्य' हो जाए:
  • Smell (State): The rose smells sweet. (गुलाब की खुशबू मीठी है — Stative)
    Smell (Active Action): She is smelling a black rose. (वह काला गुलाब सूँघ रही है — Progressive)
  • Have (Possession): She has a large house. (उसके पास बड़ा घर है — Stative)
    Have (Eating/Action): She is having lunch now. (वह अभी खाना खा रही है — Progressive)
  • Think (Opinion): I think she is honest. (मुझे लगता है वह ईमानदार है — Stative)
    Think (Mental Planning): I am thinking of moving to Delhi. (मैं दिल्ली जाने की योजना बना रहा हूँ — Progressive)

4. Present Perfect Tense & The 2 Cardinal Rules (पूर्ण वर्तमान काल (Present Perfect) एवं 2 अचूक नियम)

Structure: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object

The Present Perfect Tense represents an action completed in the past that has a direct, active link with the present moment.

Common Signal Adverbs: ever, just, already, recently, lately, yet, so far, till now, by the time.

  • "I have just finished my breakfast." (अभी-अभी खाया है).
  • "We have seen this movie already." (पहले ही देख चुके हैं).
  • "We haven't seen Reeta lately." (इधर हाल में नहीं देखा).
💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

संरचना: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object

यह काल भूतकाल और वर्तमान का संगम है — कार्य भले ही अतीत में पूरा हुआ हो, लेकिन उसका प्रभाव या संबंध वर्तमान से जुड़ा रहता है।

पहचान वाले शब्द: just (अभी-अभी), already (पहले ही), recently/lately (हाल ही में), yet/so far (अब तक - नकारात्मक वाक्यों में)।

Golden Rule 1: Present Perfect + Definite Past Point of Time = SIMPLE PASTस्वर्णिम नियम 1: Present Perfect + निश्चित बीता समय = SIMPLE PAST

If a sentence contains a definite finished point of time in the past (such as yesterday, two days ago, last year, in 1947, the other day, formerly), you MUST use Simple Past (V2), NEVER Present Perfect (has/have + V3)!

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: यदि वाक्य में बीते हुए समय का कोई निश्चित शब्द (जैसे yesterday, ago, last week, in 2020, the other day) दिया हो, तो वहाँ कभी भी Present Perfect (has/have + V3) नहीं आता, बल्कि हमेशा Simple Past (V2) आता है!

Top Recurring SSC Questions:

  • ✗ She has returned two days ago. (Incorrect — omit 'has')
    ✓ She returned two days ago. (Correct — Simple Past)✓ वह दो दिन पहले लौटी।
  • ✗ I have met your brother yesterday. (Incorrect — omit 'have')
    ✓ I met your brother yesterday. (Correct)✓ मैं कल तुम्हारे भाई से मिला।
  • ✗ India has won independence in 1947. (Incorrect)
    ✓ India won independence in 1947. (Correct)

Golden Rule 2: Present Indefinite + Time Expression = PRESENT PERFECTस्वर्णिम नियम 2: वर्तमान क्रिया + अवधि/बिंदु-समय (Since/For) = PRESENT PERFECT

When a state or action started in the past and continues into the present with since, for, how long, whole, all along, you cannot use Simple Present; you MUST use Present Perfect!

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: यदि कोई स्थिति अतीत से शुरू होकर अब तक बनी हुई है और साथ में since / for / how long लगा है, तो वहाँ Simple Present नहीं, बल्कि Present Perfect आएगा:
  • ✗ He knows me for two years. (Wrong)
    ✓ He has known me for two years. (Correct)✓ वह मुझे दो साल से जानता है।
  • ✗ She owns this parlour since 2002. (Wrong)
    ✓ She has owned this parlour since 2002. (Correct)✓ वह 2002 से इस पार्लर की मालकिन है।

5. Past Tenses & Past Perfect (The 'Past of the Past' Rule) (भूतकाल एवं Past Perfect ('भूतकाल का भूतकाल' नियम))

A. Past Indefinite (Simple Past): Subject + V2 + Object

  • Used for completed past actions with past time markers: "She bought a car two years ago."
  • Used for past habits: "He always carried an umbrella." / "I used to go to Delhi by train."

B. Past Continuous: Subject + was/were + V-ing + Object

  • Action in progress in the past: "It was still raining when I reached there."

C. Past Perfect (had + V3):

Past Perfect does NOT simply mean past; it means the earlier of two past actions!

💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

A. Past Indefinite (Simple Past): Subject + V2 + Object
बीते समय में पूरा हुआ एकल कार्य या पुरानी आदतें (used to / would): "I met him yesterday."

B. Past Perfect (had + V3) — परीक्षा का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण नियम:

जब भूतकाल में दो कार्य हुए हों, तो जो कार्य पहले पूरा हुआ, उसे Past Perfect (had + V3) में लिखा जाता है, और जो कार्य बाद में हुआ, उसे Simple Past (V2) में लिखा जाता है!

The Two Past Actions Formula (Before / After)दो बीते कार्यों का अचूक सूत्र (Before / After)

1st Action (Earlier) → Past Perfect [had + V3]
2nd Action (Later) → Simple Past [V2]
  • ✓ The patient had died before the doctor arrived.✓ डॉक्टर के आने से पहले मरीज मर चुका था। (मरीज पहले मरा = had died; डॉक्टर बाद में आया = arrived)।
  • ✓ The train had left before we reached the station.✓ हमारे स्टेशन पहुँचने से पहले ट्रेन जा चुकी थी।
  • ✓ I finished the book after I had returned from college.✓ कॉलेज से लौटने के बाद मैंने किताब खत्म की।
  • ⚡ Single Action Blunder: Never use Past Perfect for a single standalone past action without an earlier reference point!
    ✗ I had gone to Delhi last week. (Incorrect)
    ✓ I went to Delhi last week. (Correct — Simple Past)

Unfulfilled Wishes / Intentions with Past Perfectअधूरी इच्छाएं या योजनाएं (Unfulfilled Intentions)

When verbs like want, hope, expect, think, suppose, intend are used with had + V3, it indicates that the action was desired or planned, but DID NOT take place!

💡 सरल हिंदी व्याख्या: जब want, hope, expect, intend जैसी क्रियाओं के साथ had + V3 का प्रयोग होता है, तो इसका अर्थ होता है कि वह इच्छा या योजना पूरी नहीं हो सकी:
  • ✓ I had wanted to help my brother. (Meaning: but I could not help).✓ मैं अपने भाई की मदद करना चाहता था (पर कर न सका)।
  • ✓ I had expected to pass the exam. (Meaning: but I did not pass).✓ मुझे परीक्षा पास करने की उम्मीद थी (पर पास न हुआ)।
  • ✓ Vishal had intended to set up his own business. (Meaning: but could not).✓ विशाल का अपना व्यवसाय शुरू करने का इरादा था (पर न कर सका)।

6. Future Tenses & The Nuance of Shall vs Will (भविष्यत् काल एवं Shall बिनाम Will का अचूक नियम)

Structure:

  • Future Indefinite: Subject + will/shall + V1 (They will come here shortly).
  • Future Continuous: Subject + will/shall be + V-ing (She will be waiting for me when I reach).
  • Future Perfect: Subject + will/shall have + V3 (She will have prepared food before I reach home).

The Shall vs Will Rule (Normal vs Emphatic/Modal):

  • Ordinary / Neutral Future: Use Shall with 1st Person (I, We); Use Will with 2nd & 3rd Person (You, He, She, They).
  • Determination, Promise, Threat, Order, or Official Duty: The rule is REVERSED!
    • Use Will with I, We (e.g., "I will help my brother." — Firm determination).
    • Use Shall with You, He, They (e.g., "You shall not move." — Strict order; "They shall be rewarded." — Solemn promise).
💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

Shall बिनाम Will का नियम:

  • साधारण भविष्य (General Future): I / We के साथ shall; You / He / She / They के साथ will आता है।
    "I shall go to Delhi." (मैं दिल्ली जाऊँगा — जा भी सकता हूँ, नहीं भी)।
  • आदेश, वादा, दृढ़ निश्चय, कर्तव्य या धमकी (Determination/Order/Promise): नियम उल्टा हो जाता है!
    1st Person (I, We) के साथ will आता है, और 2nd/3rd Person (You, He, They) के साथ shall आता है:
    • "You shall not move." (आदेश: तुम हिलोगे नहीं)।
    • "They shall be rewarded." (वादा: उन्हें पुरस्कार दिया जाएगा)।
    • "I will crack SSC CGL 2026." (दृढ़ संकल्प: मैं परीक्षा पास करूँगा ही)।

7. Perfect Continuous Tenses & The 'Since vs For' Rule (पूर्ण चालू काल एवं 'Since बिनाम For' का सटीक नियम)

Perfect Continuous Tenses describe an action that started in the past and is still continuing into the present or up to a specified time frame.

  • Present Perfect Continuous: S + has/have been + V-ing + (since/for + time)
    "She has been suffering from fever for two days."
  • Past Perfect Continuous: S + had been + V-ing + (since/for + time)
    "She had been playing chess the whole day yesterday."

The Definitive Rule: Since vs For

  • SINCE (Point of Time): Used when the exact starting point of the action is named:
    • Specific days/dates: since Monday, since 15th August, since 2004
    • Parts of day: since morning, since noon, since evening, since night
    • Stages of life / Events: since childhood, since his birth, since I arrived here
    • Clock time: since 8:00 AM, since 4 o'clock
  • FOR (Period / Duration of Time): Used for counting numerical duration:
    • Number + units: for two hours, for ten days, for five months, for three years, for a long time
💡 सरल हिंदी में समझें (Key Concept):

Since बिनाम For का अचूक नियम:

  • SINCE (निश्चित बिंदु-समय / Point of Time): जब काम के शुरू होने का निश्चित समय, दिन, तारीख या पहर दिया हो:
    since Monday (सोमवार से), since 2010 (2010 से), since morning (सुबह से), since childhood (बचपन से), since 5 o'clock (5 बजे से)।
  • FOR (अवधि / Period of Time): जब समय की गिनती या कुल अवधि दी हो:
    for two days (दो दिन से), for five hours (पाँच घंटे से), for ten years (दस साल से), for a long time (काफी समय से)।

8. Master Summary: All 12 Tenses at a Glance (संपूर्ण सारणी: सभी 12 काल एक नज़र में)

Tense Hindi (हिंदी) Active Voice Structure (संरचना) Example Sentence (उदाहरण)
Present Indefinite सामान्य वर्तमान S + V1 (s/es) She writes letters.
Present Continuous चालू वर्तमान S + is/am/are + V-ing She is writing a letter.
Present Perfect पूर्ण वर्तमान S + has/have + V3 She has written a letter.
Present Perfect Continuous पूर्ण चालू वर्तमान S + has/have been + V-ing She has been writing for an hour.
Past Indefinite सामान्य भूतकाल S + V2 She wrote a letter.
Past Continuous चालू भूतकाल S + was/were + V-ing She was writing a letter.
Past Perfect पूर्ण भूतकाल S + had + V3 She had written a letter.
Past Perfect Continuous पूर्ण चालू भूतकाल S + had been + V-ing She had been writing for an hour.
Future Indefinite सामान्य भविष्यत् S + will/shall + V1 She will write a letter.
Future Continuous चालू भविष्यत् S + will/shall be + V-ing She will be writing a letter.
Future Perfect पूर्ण भविष्यत् S + will/shall have + V3 She will have written a letter.
Future Perfect Continuous पूर्ण चालू भविष्यत् S + will/shall have been + V-ing She will have been writing for an hour.

9. MCQs (Based on Tenses Rules) (इंटरैक्टिव अभ्यास प्रश्न (Tenses नियमों पर आधारित))

Test your understanding of the 12 Tenses and Stative Verb rules. Click an option for instant answer feedback:

Practice Question 1

Find the error: 'I am hearing (A) / a strange screeching noise (B) / coming from the attic (C) / No error (D)''I am hearing (A) / a strange screeching noise (B) / coming from the attic (C)' में त्रुटि पहचानें:

title: Prepositions (पूर्वसर्ग)
excerpt: Preposition rules: Accusative case, confusion pairs (between/among, in/into, beside/besides), omission rules, and 350+ fixed prepositions A-Z.
seo_description: Preposition rules: Accusative case, confusion pairs (between/among, in/into, beside/besides), omission rules, and 350+ fixed prepositions A-Z.
content:
1 Preposition की परिभाषा एवं आधारभूत व्याकरणिक नियम

Preposition हमेशा अपने बाद आने वाले Noun/Pronoun का संबंध वाक्य के दूसरे Noun, Verb या Adjective से जोड़ता है:

1. Prepositional Object (Accusative Case)

Preposition के बाद आने वाला Noun या Pronoun हमेशा Objective / Accusative Case में रहता है (I → me, he → him):
• The book is on the table. (table = object)
• I did not talk to him. (to he गलत है)
• Distribute between you and me. (between you and I गलत है)

2. Preposition + Gerund (V1+ing)

यदि Preposition के तुरंत बाद कोई क्रिया (Verb) आती है, तो वह अनिवार्य रूप से Gerund (V1+ing) के रूप में आती है (To को छोड़कर):
• He is fond of reading books.
• She prevented me from going there.
• He was punished for telling lies.

3. End Position with Infinitive

जब Noun के बाद कोई Infinitive (To + V1) उसके उद्देश्य या साधन को व्यक्त करे, तो उचित Preposition वाक्य के अंत में आता है:
• I have no house to live in.
• Give me a pen to write with.
• He is a man you can rely upon.

2 Preposition के 8 सबसे बड़े भ्रमकारी युग्म (Confusion Pairs)

SSC परीक्षाओं में सबसे अधिक प्रश्न इन समान अर्थ वाले Prepositions के अंतर पर पूछे जाते हैं:

1. Between vs. Among / Amongst

  • • Between: सामान्यतः दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के लिए।
    Divide this apple between Ram and Shyam.
  • • Among: दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के लिए।
    Distribute the sweets among the children.
  • • SSC Trap: दो से अधिक होने पर भी यदि उनके बीच कोई आपसी समझौता या संबंध (Reciprocal Relationship) हो, तो Between ही आता है:
    There is a treaty between the four nations. (not among)

2. In vs. Into (स्थिरता बिनाम गति)

  • • In (अंदर • स्थिरता): पहले से ही किसी सीमा के भीतर स्थिर होना।
    She is sitting in the room. / He swims in the river.
  • • Into (अंदर की ओर गति / माध्यम परिवर्तन): बाहर से अंदर की ओर गति या अवस्था बदलना।
    The frog jumped into the pond. / Translate this passage into English.
  • • Trap: Enter के साथ स्थान में प्रवेश के लिए into नहीं लगता (He entered the room, not entered into)।

3. Beside vs. Besides (बगल में बिनाम के अलावा)

  • • Beside: पास में / बगल में (By the side of)।
    Go and sit beside your mother. (अपनी माँ के बगल में बैठो)
  • • Besides: के अतिरिक्त / के अलावा (In addition to)।
    Besides English, he can speak French. (अंग्रेजी के अलावा)

4. By vs. With (कर्ता बिनाम उपकरण / हथियार)

  • • By: कार्य करने वाले सजीव कर्ता (Agent / Doer) के लिए।
    The tiger was killed by the hunter.
